glossary.pid: P&ID (piping and instrumentation diagram): the engineering drawing of a plant, showing equipment, valves and instruments and the pipes and signal lines that connect them. A large plant's P&ID is split over many sheets.
glossary.sheet: Drawing sheet: one page of the P&ID, identified by its DWG number. Each page of the PDF on the left is one sheet.
glossary.off_page_connector: Off-page connector: the flag-shaped symbol at a sheet's edge ("TO DWG 12") saying that a pipe or signal line continues on another sheet. The system uses these flags to join all sheets into one graph.
glossary.tag: Tag: the identifier of an item on the drawing, such as P-151-1. The same item can appear on several sheets; the system treats them as one item.
glossary.unit: Process unit: a section of the plant that belongs together, with its own number.
glossary.graph_db: Graph database (Neo4j): stores the whole plant as a graph so it can be queried. It holds one plant at a time, so switching plants reloads it.
glossary.cypher: Cypher: the query language of the Neo4j graph database. In step 1 the language model writes such a query, and the database answers it from the graph of the whole plant.
glossary.agent: Graph agent: step 2. The language model explores the plant graph step by step with tools (search, neighbours, path), sheet by sheet.
glossary.cascade: Cascade: the two steps in order. The database query tries first; if the system does not accept its answer, the question goes to the graph agent.
glossary.k: k: how many links in the correct answer's evidence cross from one drawing sheet to another, through an off-page connector or because the same item is drawn on both sheets. The larger k, the more the question spans sheets.
glossary.u: u: how many links in the correct answer's evidence cross from one process unit to another.
glossary.model_time: Model time: the time of the language-model calls plus local computing, counted the way the evaluation counts it.
glossary.lost_time: Lost time: the model provider returned errors and the system retried the call. This time is not the model's thinking time.
glossary.wall_time: Answer time: how long this answer took on this machine, from pressing Ask to the result (without emptying the model cache or loading a plant).
glossary.wilson: Wilson interval: the 95 % confidence band around a measured accuracy; it is wider when there are few questions.
glossary.context_wall: Context wall: the number of sheets above which the text of the whole drawing set no longer fits into the language model's input.
glossary.context_rag: ContextRAG: the published method measured on single sheets; it puts the whole graph as text into the model's input.
